title: US Democrats Win Congress With an Affordability Promise, but Can They Lower Prices?
shortdescription: Democrats have won control of Congress promising relief from high food, fuel and healthcare costs. But President Trump's veto power and economic pressures could limit what they achieve.

title: Global AI Stock Selloff Deepens After Democratic Midterm Victory Raises Data Centre Concerns
shortdescription: Global technology shares tumble after Democratic midterm victories raise fears of stricter AI data-centre rules, adding to concerns about valuations and the returns on massive AI investments.

title: TMC MP’s Arrested During Protests Against ED’s I-PAC Raids
shortdescription: TMC leaders, including MPs Mahua Moitra and Derek O’Brien, were arrested by Delhi police during a protest against ED raids on the I-PAC office in Kolkata.
description: Mamata Banerjee accuses the government of using the agency for political targeting ahead of West Bengal elections.
author: Macro Anton
